name: functions
description: Serverless event-driven compute for background processing, triggers, and microservices

defaultConfig.note: Consumption plan (Y1) for event-driven workloads — pay per execution. Use EP1 (Elastic Premium) for VNet integration or pre-warmed instances.

Y1.note: Consumption — pay per execution, cold starts, free grant of 1M executions/month

B1.note: Dedicated plan (shared with App Service), always-on, ~$13/month

integration.identityNote: Functions use managed identity same as App Service. Storage account is required for function runtime (even with managed identity, the host needs AzureWebJobsStorage).

appSettings.name: AzureWebJobsStorage__accountName
appSettings.description: Storage account for Functions runtime (uses identity-based connection)

bicepWiring.storageConnection: For Functions v4+ with managed identity, use 'AzureWebJobsStorage__accountName' (no connection string). Assign 'Storage Blob Data Owner' + 'Storage Queue Data Contributor' + 'Storage Table Data Contributor' to the managed identity on the storage account.

connectsTo.description: Functions connect to downstream services same as App Service — via managed identity + environment variables. Additionally, trigger connections use __fullyQualifiedNamespace or __accountEndpoint suffix pattern for identity-based triggers.
connectsTo.triggerConnectionPattern:
For identity-based trigger connections (no connection strings):
- Service Bus: ServiceBusConnection__fullyQualifiedNamespace
- Cosmos DB: CosmosDBConnection__accountEndpoint
- Storage: AzureWebJobsStorage__accountName
- Event Grid: uses push model (no pull trigger)
